question: Can the editorial responsibility for the 2004 《芸香阁丛书——冀淑英文集》 be tied to a named editor without inferring the authorship of the final 《編后記》, the secondary-reported 《编者注》, or the 2010 《〈冀淑英文集〉补遣》?
answer: Yes, at the volume/project editorial-responsibility layer. A 2009 China News report of Chen Hongyan's National Library of China lecture identifies her biography as having edited/compiled 《芸香阁丛书——冀淑英文集》. A National Library of China / China Ancient Books Preservation Network article independently describes the post-2000 Yunxiangge collected-works project and explicitly places Chen Hongyan among the National Library/publisher participants who handled the project with the families of the scholars represented in the series. Together these close Chen Hongyan's editorial responsibility for the Wenji/Yunxiangge project. They do not expose the colophon or signature of the final 《編后記》, do not prove that 《編后記》 is the same object as the secondary-reported 《编者注》, and do not identify the author of the 2010 supplement article.
